review:
The space fruits are back, and this time the multipliers stick. Fruit characters and space gems drop onto refilling reels, and multipliers can show up on any winning spin.

The bonus gives 15 free spins (three or more scatters add five more), and every multiplier that lands stacks up and stays put – so the total keeps climbing instead of resetting. That's where the big hits come from. Very high volatility, 5,000x max, and a 97.17% RTP, which is a big step up from the first game. Free spins come round more often too, roughly once every 163 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.17% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
